name: Bloodwright
description:
About This Game



DESCEND INTO THE DARK

Bloodwright is a dark fantasy action RPG rogue-lite where every descent into the dungeon offers greater rewards and greater danger.

Fight your way through procedurally generated floors filled with deadly enemies, powerful bosses, rare loot, and forgotten secrets.

Defeat the floor boss and choose your fate:

Return home with your rewards, or push deeper into the abyss in search of greater power.

RISK EVERYTHING

Every run is a gamble.

The deeper you descend, the more valuable your rewards become but death comes at a price.

If you fall within the dungeon, everything carried on your character is lost.

Only your stash, character progression, and permanent upgrades remain.

Will you escape while you're ahead?

Or risk one more floor?

BUILD YOUR CHARACTER

Discover powerful weapons, armor, spells, and affixes that can transform your playstyle.

Experiment with unique combinations and devastating synergies:

  • Chain Lightning triggering from Whirlwind

  • Meteor on hit bleed build

  • Enemies explode when they die triggering a chain reaction

  • Rare affixes that reshape entire builds

No two runs are ever quite the same.

GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN

Even failed expeditions contribute to your progress.

Gain experience, unlock permanent upgrades through Sevrik's Soul Tree, expand your collection of gear, and prepare for deeper descents.

Each run brings new opportunities to grow stronger.

FORGE YOUR LEGACY

Salvage unwanted equipment and transform it into valuable crafting materials.

Work alongside the blacksmith to forge new gear, improve your arsenal, and prepare for the dangers waiting below.

Every item has value.

Even broken steel can become something greater.

Key Features

  • Souls-inspired melee combat

  • Procedurally generated dungeon floors

  • Powerful bosses guarding each descent

  • Risk-versus-reward extraction gameplay

  • Deep loot and affix system

  • Build-defining spells and synergies

  • Permanent progression and skill tree upgrades

  • Salvage and crafting systems

  • Single-player experience

  • Endless replayability
short_desc: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG rogue-lite.
